why_headers_survive_all_flags_on_7141.mechanism: libhiprtc-builtins.so.7 EMBEDS a HIP-specific C++ header subset (strings evidence: __hip_internal numeric_limits templates, '#include <type_traits>', '#include <limits>', '#include <utility>' strings) that hipRTC registers on the RTC include search path independent of the clang driver's standard/builtin include machinery
why_headers_survive_all_flags_on_7141.consequence: -nostdinc / -nostdinc++ / -nobuiltininc / --sysroot do not affect the embedded builtin registration; <type_traits>/<limits>/<initializer_list> (+stddef.h) stay reachable while <utility> (not embedded at top level as includable header) disappears with the system libc++ dir
why_headers_survive_all_flags_on_7141.version_difference: system 7.2.1 hiprtc does NOT show this behavior (-nostdinc++ removes all four) — documented toolchain behavioral difference, NOT a validation-environment option (7.2.1 mixing is forbidden)

environment_classification.B_partial_STL: REPRODUCIBLE (-nostdinc++: type_traits=1 utility=0 limits=1 initializer_list=1; ordinary kernel OK; -nostdinc identical). This exercises the patch's inconsistent-availability (__has_include) guard exactly: one wrapper header reachable, the other not

environment_classification.D_unusable_config: none observed — every tested combination kept the ordinary control kernel compilable and executable
